utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Good morning to everybody in and around the courtroom. Madam Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning to everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case number IT-04-81-T, The Prosecutor versus Momcilo Perisic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. May we have the appearances for today, starting with the Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. THOMAS
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning to everyone in and around the courtroom. Barney Thomas, Salvatore Cannata, and Carmela Javier for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. And for the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning to everyone in the courtroom. Mr. Perisic's Defence today is represented by Milos Androvic, Daniela Tasic, Gregor Guy-Smith, and Novak Lukic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much, Mr. Lukic. Good morning, sir.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning to everyone.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Just to remind you that you are still bound by the declaration you made at the beginning of your testimony to tell the truth, the whole truth, and nothing else but the truth, okay? Mr. Lukic. Before you start, should we or should we not go into private session?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, yes. This is what I was going ask for, Your Honour. We need to return to private session, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. May the Chamber please move into private session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, we're back in open session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar. Yes, Mr. Cannata.

utterances.speaker: MR. CANNATA
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. Just one housekeeping matter I wish to raise. It concerns some of the exhibits tendered through Witness Dr. Nakas. As Your Honours might recall, there was some exhibits admitted as MFI, marked for identification, on account of some translation issues that we have with the documents. Now those issues have been resolved, and with the agreement with the Defence, I'm going ask you to move these exhibits from MFI to proper exhibits. And with your leave, I'm going to give you the following exhibit numbers. Those exhibits would be P221, P222, P224, P22 -- sorry, let me strike these and start again. I apologise. Now the exhibits will be P2221, P2222, P2224, P2226, P2227, P2228, and P2229. And the Prosecution asks for those documents to be exhibited properly and with no reference to MFI.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Cannata. Mr. Cannata, the Chamber was going to render an oral decision just now in relation to some other exhibits about which the parties also have agreed that the MFI might be removed. Are you absolutely sure these ones that you are referring are not part of the motion that was filed on the 6th of April, which is yesterday?

utterances.speaker: MR. GUY-SMITH
utterances.text: The answer to that would be, yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Yes, they are not part of that?

utterances.speaker: MR. GUY-SMITH
utterances.text: Yes, they are not part of that. Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. What is the Defence's response to these ones that Mr. Cannata is referring to?

utterances.speaker: MR. GUY-SMITH
utterances.text: Mr. Cannata has accurately indicated what the agreement is between the parties with regard to these exhibits now that they have been corrected.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Madam Registrar, those exhibits which were marked for identification, there about one, two, three, four, five, six, seven of them, starting with P2221 to 2229. May the MFI please be removed from them.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, the status of those will be changed to exhibit.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. Was that all the housekeeping you had, sir?

utterances.speaker: MR. CANNATA
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. Before I call you again, may I deal with the housekeeping from the Chamber. On the 6th of April, 2009 the Defence filed its partly confidential notification on the MFI documents tendered via Bretton Randall, whereby it withdrew its previous objections and agreed to admission into evidence of 183 documents previously MFI'd by the Trial Chamber during the testimony of Bretton Randall. The Trial Chamber therefore admits into evidence as exhibits the documents listed in the confidential Annex A to the Defence notification. And that the -- the status be removed from marked for identification to full exhibits. Mr. Thomas.

utterances.speaker: MR. THOMAS
utterances.text: Yes, sir. I can address you, Your Honours, that concludes not just the housekeeping matters but also the evidence for today and for the week.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Oh, does it then -- that means we postpone to the 20th.

utterances.speaker: MR. THOMAS
utterances.text: I understand that is now to the 21st, Tuesday the 21st of April.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: But I saw some surprise on the Defence faces. Was that not what you expected, gentlemen?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, we're not surprised, but I was more actually confused by your -- what you said, that it is on the 20th, because my understanding was that we are resuming on the 21st, because that's what I heard yesterday, that we are resuming on Tuesday, the 23rd.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: I have heard that rumour. But I have looked at the schedule from the people who control the court schedule, and I have seen us scheduled for the 20th. And being an obedient child, I thought, I'm going to stick to the schedule. What is the reason we're not sitting on the 20th?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] If I may just say, on behalf of the Defence, that we are ready, and, as far as the Defence team, we're all going to be here whenever you say we should be here to resume.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: That is not my question, Mr. Lukic. My question is do you know what the reason for us not sitting on the 20th?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The Defence does not have any information to that effect.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: I have been appropriately apprised. Thank you so much. Then we stand adjourned to the 21st of April, Courtroom I, 9.00 in the morning. Court adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 21st day of April, 2009, at 9.00 a.m. 21 22 23 24

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 9.44 a.m.,
